title: Original immutable 603-coffee audit: 50 unresolved source ambiguities, individually classified
scope: Reviewed captured source evidence only; not fresh roaster fact check or a production edit
work_policy: Do not choose from contradictory current claims; preserve labeled source facts and ask the roaster/member for precise lot, product variant, current claim or cultivar. No live source confirmation performed.
review_status: 50 original source ambiguity records individually classified: 1 invalid autofill safely withheld by candidate, 49 continue to require source/variant/roaster confirmation. No new live website reads.
